summary: F1 and F2 are fixed. A full demo VM now refuses new visitors with 503, instead of evicting active ones. Running instances answer before the queue. `publish` refuses template demo records. Both fixes are tested. The change is not ready, because the temp run fails: one control-plane temp test still expects the old 404 when a demo instance fails to start. Because that run failed, coverage for the control-plane files was lost and the coverage gate failed.

findings.body:
The test "demo instances restart after a crash and report capacity failures" fails: `expected 503 to be 404`.

Cause: `connectViewer` now returns the start error, and `serveExtensionRequest` answers 503 "This demo is busy…" (extensionProxy.ts:49-56).

Fix: update the test so that, when the instance fails to start, it expects 503 with that body and the `retry-after` header.

Because this file fails, the control-plane vitest run reported no coverage. Every changed line in AppService.ts, AppStore.ts, templateHttp.ts, controlPlaneHttp.ts, controlPlaneRpcRouter.ts and halo-cli app.ts, plus several workspace-server lines, is now reported uncovered. Rerun the tests after the fix and confirm that the coverage gate passes. Also remove the stray `infra/workspace/.tmp-tests/__pycache__/*.pyc` files from the temp test folder.
